decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to use cards like Neoform, Grisly Salvage, and Thoughtseize to manipulate the graveyard and find specific creatures. The goal is to create a Soulflayer with a combination of powerful abilities from creatures like Tasigur, the Golden Fang, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Zetalpa, Primal Dawn. Founding the Third Path and Otherworldly Gaze provide additional ways to search and manipulate the deck, while cards like Collective Brutality and Hooting Mandrills help control the game state. The land base supports the deck's colors and provides appropriate mana fixing. The deck's strategy revolves around the synergy and power of Soulflayer.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board while creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger put pressure on the opponent. The addition of powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds versatility and resilience to the deck. With a mix of high-value creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of aggression and control.

The deck revolves around using Neoform to sacrifice creatures and tutor for specific threats or combo pieces, while utilizing Atraxa as a versatile and powerful creature to support the strategy. The deck also includes various disruption spells and card draw effects to control the game and find key cards quickly. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional mana and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the key concept is to efficiently assemble combos and outvalue opponents with a well-rounded mix of creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to gain advantage and disrupt the opponent's board state. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to control the board while dealing incremental damage. Mayhem Devil acts as a key piece in this strategy, dealing damage whenever a permanent is sacrificed. The deck also includes disruption elements like Claim the Firstborn and Thoughseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base includes a mix of dual lands to support the deck's color requirements.

The deck focuses on creating a powerful board presence through a combination of creatures and vehicles, using cards like Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate advantage. It also includes a mix of disruption and card selection spells to control the game and ensure the combo pieces come together smoothly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's high casting cost cards, with a variety of dual lands and a couple of utility lands to round out the strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing ramp strategies with Omnath, Locus of Creation as the key card to generate mana and gain advantage over opponents. The deck also includes control elements such as Leyline Binding and Chained to the Rocks to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Bring to Light allows for versatile tutor options, while cards like Escape to the Wilds provide card advantage. The inclusion of various lands, including triomes and unique lands like Boseiju, Who Endures, adds consistency and flexibility to the mana base. Ultimately, the deck aims to ramp quickly and control the game to secure a win.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply early pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand while using removal spells such as Fatal Push and Dreadbore to deal with threats. The deck leverages powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and synergistic cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain board presence and generate advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression, disruption, and value.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, board wipes, and planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It also utilizes card draw and token generation to maintain card advantage and create threats. The mana base includes utility lands to support the control game plan. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while gradually gaining control of the battlefield and winning through incremental advantages.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with Enigmatic Incarnation, using various creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing Fires of Invention to cast multiple spells each turn, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Dragonlord Atarka and Elesh Norn. Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown provide additional disruption, while the companion Keruga, the Macrosage allows for card advantage. The mana base is built to support the deck's five-color requirements, ensuring consistent access to the diverse array of spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality to disrupt the opponent's game plan while using cards like Vessel of Nascency and Grisly Salvage to find key pieces of the combo. The deck also includes cards like Esika's Chariot and Raffine's Informant to provide additional value and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolor requirements while including utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for protection.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate large amounts of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells such as Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. By utilizing cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, the player can untap Lotus Field multiple times in a turn to generate even more mana. The deck also includes cards like Behold the Beyond and Mastermind's Acquisition to tutor for key combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Ultimately, the goal is to assemble a game-winning combo or overwhelming advantage through efficient mana generation and powerful spells.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Lotus Field and lands that untap it efficiently to generate a large amount of mana in order to cast game-winning spells. This deck aims to dig through the library quickly to find its key pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan while searching for its win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Mastermind's Acquisition allows for flexibility in finding specific cards needed for the situation. It also utilizes cards like Dark Petition and Bala Ged Recovery to recur key pieces from the graveyard.

The deck focuses on utilizing the card Neoform to quickly assemble a powerful board presence by sacrificing creatures to search for key combo pieces such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Tasigur, the Golden Fang. The deck also includes efficient disruption such as Stubborn Denial and Thoughtseize to control the game and protect the combo strategy. By efficiently utilizing cards like Founding the Third Path and Otherworldly Gaze for card selection and filtering, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, combined with removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to control the board. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional value and disruption. The deck also has a grindy element with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Misery's Shadow, ensuring that it can maintain pressure and outvalue the opponent in longer games.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to control the opponent's hand and board. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats and recursion options. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and finish the game quickly with efficient threats and removal spells.

This Aggro-Weenie White deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence with low-cost creatures like Hopeful Initiate and Skrelv, Defector Mite. Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar pump up the team, while cards like Ossification and Brutal Cathar provide removal and protection. The deck also includes mana-producing lands like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale to ensure a consistent flow of creatures. Overall, the strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures and maintaining control of the battlefield.
